description: quartermaster: a SessionEnd tally of this session's friction (streamed locally, no LLM, no network) and a SessionStart line that keeps the capability-capture charter in front of Claude (turn the thing done three times into a skill, map entry, rule, or measurement) and has Claude proactively offer a focused optimization round once enough unreviewed sessions or friction events pile up. Neither hook analyzes content or changes anything; current or explicit standing user permission authorizes the round, and each recommendation is separately approved unless the same standing permission covers that class of change.
